test_consistency: test the CLIP JIT and Python model outputs produce consistent softmax probabilities
run_test_consistency: run pytest on test_consistency to verify JIT and native CLIP model equivalence
review_test_consistency: review the test_consistency function that compares JIT and Python CLIP model outputs
refactor_test_consistency: refactor test_consistency to add tolerance parameters or additional model comparison checks
summarize_test_consistency: summarize the test_consistency function that validates CLIP model consistency across JIT and Python
